newsitem.title: USA: Granite Construction wins $75.7 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Granite Construction wins $75.7 mln contract.

text.p: Granite Construction Inc said its Granite Construction Co unit won a $75.7 million contract from the Florida Department of Transportation to widen about five miles of Interstate 4, east of Tampa, Florida.
The project will include 1.2 million cubic yards of earthwork, drill-casting and related excavation, the company said.
Construction is scheduled to start by early October and take about three and a half years to complete, the company added.
